    <h2>{`About this task`}</h2>
    <p>{`This is a simple approach to include Quotation/Estimate section from Service Provider module. Its purpose aims to list estimates/quotes for a work order in the Report Work page and a dialog to add new entries to estimate/quote.
The coding portion should be placed inside AppCustomizations.js.`}</p>
    <h2>{`Prerequisites`}</h2>
    <p>{`It requires a relationship between Work Order and Worklog of time “ESTIMATE”. The relationship must be part of the work order object structure, in this example the relationship used is “pluspcustpricest”.`}</p>
    <h2>{`Procedure`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Step 1: Add a new datasource as child from datasource woDetailsReportWork inside report work page.`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<maximo-datasource id="woDetailsReportWork" [...]>
    <!-- [...] -->
    <maximo-datasource id="estimateWorkLogDS" id-attribute="worklogid" object-name="worklog" relationship="pluspcustpricest" depends-on="woDetailsReportWork" selection-mode="none"/>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Step 2: Add a new panel to accommodate the list of estimates/quotes`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`    <page id="report_work" [...]>
    <!-- [...] -->
    <panel id="estimateWorkLogPanel">
        <box padding-start=".5" id="anjb7"/>
        <border-layout padding="{app.state.screen.size === 'sm' || app.state.screen.size === 'md' ? 'false' : 'true'}" fill-parent="true" id="kwz3r">
            <top background-color="ui-02" id="ery3p">
            <border-layout fill-parent="true" id="m92gw">
                <start shrink="1" direction="column" vertical-align="center" id="zzgrn">
                <box direction="row" vertical-align="center" padding-top=".5" padding-start="{app.state.screen.size === 'sm' || app.state.screen.size === 'md' ? '.5' : '0'}" id="dkn7x">
                    <label label="Quotation" theme="20-regular" id="dn8za"/>
                </box>
                </start>
                <middle id="mn_ey" width="100"/>
                <end direction="row" vertical-align="end" horizontal-align="end" id="va9pm">
                <button kind="ghost" padding="false" icon="carbon:add" loading="{page.state.failureEdit}" on-click="quotationDrawerOpen" on-click-arg="{{'datasource': estimateWorkLogDS, 'page': page, 'action':'add'}}" id="dr3bz"/>
                </end>
            </border-layout>
            </top>
            <middle id="mzk2g">
            <data-list datasource="estimateWorkLogDS" margin="false" show-search="false" empty-row-style="true" empty-set-string="No quotation available." id="mw5d2">
                <list-item id="pj4a_">
                <adaptive-row id="dzyky">
                    <adaptive-column small-width="80" medium-width="90" large-width="40" small-horizontal-align="start" medium-horizontal-align="start" large-horizontal-align="start" id="e9ww7">
                    <box direction="column" children-hide-overflow="true" padding-top="{app.state.screen.size === 'sm' || app.state.screen.size === 'md' ? '-.5' : '.75'}" vertical-align="center" fill-parent="true" min-width="100%" id="gvp76">
                        <label label="create by: {item.createby}" id="qr7xv"/>
                        <label label="create date: {item.createdate}" id="a746q"/>
                    </box>
                    </adaptive-column>
                    <adaptive-column small-width="80" medium-width="90" large-width="25" small-horizontal-align="start" medium-horizontal-align="start" large-horizontal-align="start" id="j83n3">
                    <box vertical-align="center" children-hide-overflow="true" padding-top="{app.state.screen.size === 'sm' || app.state.screen.size === 'md' ? '-.5' : '.75'}" horizontal-align="start" fill-parent="true" min-width="100%" id="r3k8y">
                        <label label="summary: {item.description}" id="rjv6q"/>
                        <label label="estimate price: {item.plusppriceest}" id="wv7e9"/>
                    </box>
                    </adaptive-column>
                    <adaptive-column small-width="80" medium-width="90" large-width="25" small-horizontal-align="start" medium-horizontal-align="start" large-horizontal-align="end" id="py2jw">
                    <box direction="column" children-hide-overflow="true" padding-top="{app.state.screen.size === 'sm' || app.state.screen.size === 'md' ? '-.5' : '.75'}" vertical-align="center" fill-parent="true" min-width="100%" id="e_n2g">
                        <label label="status: {item.pluspeststat}" id="zg65b"/>
                        <label label="valid until: {item.pluspestenddt}" id="r2d2p"/>
                    </box>
                    </adaptive-column>
                </adaptive-row>
                </list-item>
            </data-list>
            </middle>
        </border-layout>
    </panel>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Step 3: Create a sliding drawer at dialogs in report_work page.`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`    <dialogs id="wvvzx">
    <!-- [...] -->
    <!-- Quotation Drawer Start -->
    <sliding-drawer id="estimateWorkLogDrawer" align="start" header-text="New Estimate/Quote" content-padding="false" validate="quotationDrawerValidate" on-close-action="onCloseQuotationDrawer" on-close-action-arg="{{'page':page,'app':app,'ds':reportworkLaborDetailds}}">
        <panel id="v62b_">
        <border-layout fill-parent="true" padding="false" id="dvam5">
            <start width="100" background-color="ui-01" horizontal-overflow="hidden" id="ev_dp">
            <box padding-bottom="0.25" direction="column" fill-parent-horizontal="true" id="b7pyy">
                <border-layout fill-parent="true" padding="true" middle-border="true" id="jzr8n">
                <start width="90" background-color="ui-01" horizontal-overflow="hidden" id="n9g2_">
                    <box padding-top=".25" padding-bottom=".25" fill-parent="true" id="dy8q7">
                    <smart-input value="{estimateWorkLogDS.item.description}" id="quoteSummary" required="true" label="Summary" placeholder="Enter new quote description"/>
                    </box>
                </start>
                </border-layout>
            </box>
            <box padding-bottom="0.25" direction="column" fill-parent-horizontal="true" id="gb6w3">
                <border-layout fill-parent="true" padding="true" middle-border="true" id="kmn43">
                <start width="90" background-color="ui-01" horizontal-overflow="hidden" id="wapq4">
                    <box padding-top=".25" padding-bottom=".25" fill-parent="true" id="jbrbx">
                    <smart-input value="{estimateWorkLogDS.item.plusppriceest}" id="quotePriceEstimate" required="true" label="Price Estimate"/>
                    </box>
                </start>
                </border-layout>
            </box>
            </start>
        </border-layout>
        </panel>
        <button-group slot="header-button" id="jbm8n">
        <button icon="carbon:checkmark--outline" on-click="quotationDrawerSave" on-click-arg="{{'datasource': estimateWorkLogDS,'page':page,'app':app}}" kind="primary" id="ew6pe"/>
        </button-group>
    </sliding-drawer>
    <!-- Quotation Drawer End -->
    <!-- [...] -->
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Step 4: Create the method defined at report work page to open the drawer.`}</h3>
    <blockquote>
      <p parentName="blockquote">{`Always remember to declared and set contants used in the code. Like `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`TAG`}</inlineCode>{` in the example below.`}</p>
    </blockquote>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`    async quotationDrawerOpen(args,event,c) {
        const {datasource, page, action} = args;

        this.app.log.d(TAG,\`Open quotation drawer\`);
        if (datasource && page && action === 'add') {
            // Create new item
            const newItem = await datasource.addNew();
            newItem.description = " ";
            newItem.plusppriceest = 0;
            page.showDialog("estimateWorkLogDrawer");
        }
    }
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Step 5: Create the method to save the form data, in this case a new quotation.`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`    async quotationDrawerSave(args,event) {
        const {datasource, page} = args;
        this.app.log.d(TAG,\`Save quotation drawer\`);
        try {
            if (datasource.hasNewItems()) {
                await datasource.save();
            }
            page.findDialog("estimateWorkLogDrawer").closeDialog();
        } catch(er) {
            this.app.log.e(TAG,\`Error during quotation drawer save\`);
        }
    }
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Step 6: Create the method to handle close dialog button click by reverting the newly created record.`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`    onCloseQuotationDrawer(args,event) {
        const {app, ds, page} = args;
        this.app.log.d(TAG,\`Close quotation drawer\`);
        if (ds) {
            ds.undoAll();
        }
    }
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Step 7: It is possible to add a validation method to the drawer. This method will be called when the user tries to save the form.`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`    quotationDrawerValidate() {
        this.app.log.d(TAG,\`Validate quotation drawer form\`);
    }
`}</code></pre>

    </MDXLayout>;
}
;
